conformanceDimensionMachineTokens.reason: Adds candidate machine-safe aliases while preserving the published v0.8.2 human dimension label governance/policy; the reference validator accepts both spellings.

promotionProfileShapeAcyclicScopeOrderin.reason: shacl/promotion-profile.ttl gained a sh:sparql constraint rejecting a cyclic skos:broader ordering between kee:sourceScope and kee:scope. Reproduced against both shape versions with tests/shacl/valid/promotion.ttl plus one triple making the two scopes mutually skos:broader, composed with the governance-transition parent shape: the v0.8.2 baseline shape reports conforms = True and the v0.9 candidate shape reports conforms = False, while the unmutated control fixture conforms under both. That is a real conformance-behaviour change. It is MINOR-compatible and not a SemVer violation because docs/profiles/promotion-profile.md is Status: Draft / Non-Normative Design Note and ADR-0074 Section 2 excludes draft profiles from the public normative API; it also arguably implements Section 13.2's existing requirement for a machine-checkable ordering proving the target scope is strictly broader.
promotionProfileShapeAcyclicScopeOrderin.toolingNote: tools/normative_api_diff.py cannot see this change. diff() walks the keys of two JSON manifests, and shacl/, schemas/skos/, context/ and the RO-Crate examples are in neither, so the tool printed "unclassified": [] and exited 0 beside it. The same blindness would miss a tightening of an Accepted / Normative profile's shape, which would be MAJOR-class under ADR-0074 Section 6. Recorded here so the gap is visible at the point of use; the remedy is escalated as ESC-04 in docs/release/KEE-v0.9.0-sixth-pass-escalations.md.

promotionRequirements.reason: Adds independent interoperability evidence as a requirement for new profile promotion/graduation claims, not as a new obligation on existing v0.8.2 conformance claims.
